526:t_3:61.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「He broke through all those enemies?」

526:t_3:64.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I won't hand this girl over!!」

526:t_3:65.en:
$$宗介$$
「Get out of the way, Major!!」

526:t_3:69.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「We won't let you past!!」

526:t_4:5.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You seem quite energetic. I thought you would be in shock after shooting him.」

526:t_4:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$ and everyone else are fighting. I can't be the only one doing nothing.」

526:t_4:7.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「So you acquired a gun in the chaos of our escape.」

526:t_4:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「This time... I won't hesitate to shoot.」

526:t_4:10.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「People who have no intention of pulling the trigger shouldn't carry guns. It wastes time, and unpredictable accidents can happen.」

526:t_4:11.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I thought you'd just learned that firsthand.」

526:t_4:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then can you shoot him? Can you shoot $$宗介$$?」

526:t_4:13.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I don't know much about their relationship... But I know how reassuring his voice sounds when $$宗介$$ talks about this man...)

526:t_4:17.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「In fact, I ordered my men to eliminate him. I have sufficient reason to do so.」

526:t_4:18.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You probably can't understand, having never truly committed yourself to anything.」

526:t_4:20.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Think that if you wish.」

526:t_4:21.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Now... Shoot if you want to.」

526:t_4:22.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Even I know shooting you here won't change the situation.」

526:t_4:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But what happens if I shoot this component behind me?」

526:t_4:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「This is an $$アクシオン財団$$ $$グラーティア$$, right? Then if I shoot through this control panel, the container will be forcibly purged.」

526:t_4:26.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That means everyone here will fall into the sea.」

526:t_4:27.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Your target wasn't a bad choice... But do you intend to throw away your own life too?」

526:t_4:29.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「If you accept that, shoot.」

526:t_4:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
(...One little girl stealing a single gun won't change anything...)

526:t_4:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Will I... never see him again?」

526:t_4:32.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「That's right. You won't see him. ...Give me the gun.」

526:t_4:33.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...I don't want to give it back...」

526:t_4:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If I can't see $$宗介$$... then I...」

526:t_4:35.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You intend to take your own life...?」

526:t_4:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
(If I pull this trigger, it'll all be easier... My fear, anguish, despair, and guilt over shooting $$レナード$$ will all disappear...)

526:t_4:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
(There's not a shred of hope left...)

526:t_4:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I want to die... I want to die... I want to die...)

526:t_4:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I have to make him believe that... That's the last chance I have left...)

526:t_4:43.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Stop. I'll do everything I can.」

526:t_4:44.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Take this ship back to the base.」

526:t_4:45.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「That's... difficult at present. Any further delay in $$レナード$$'s treatment will endanger his life.」

526:t_4:46.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「First, calm down and lower the gun.」

526:t_4:47.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Then let me use the radio...」

526:t_4:49.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I want to say goodbye to him... Then I'll... give up...」

526:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $$クロウ$$. You seem to have done splendidly.」

526:t_10:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I didn't do as much as $$宗介$$ or $n, but I had my own feelings about this battle.」

526:t_10:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah. They've lost their commander and anywhere to go. I guess putting them out of their misery is my job.」

526:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That sentimentality of yours produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to our stock.」

526:t_10:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So I personally earned those $$Ｚチップ$$s?」

526:t_10:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Maybe I'll ask Captain $$ジェフリー$$ for a contract to buy the $$Ｚチップ$$s I produce on a commission basis...」

526:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're as miserly as ever... I was a fool for feeling even a momentary flutter in my heart.」

526:t_10:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I don't want to hear that from a notorious chip miser like you.」

526:t_10:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If you want to call yourself that, go develop a knack for drawing the short straw.」

526:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a dimensional merchant, I must say no thank you to poverty.」

526:t_10:22.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「We continued to fight during your absence. I welcome you back aboard the flagship.」

526:t_10:23.en:
$$アル$$
「You are impressive, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. You appear to have become even more powerful.」

526:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「While you were away, $$チェインバー#pilot$$ became more than a Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface System.」

526:t_10:25.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit now supports what is referred to as Ensign $$レド$$'s life.」
